chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 36: Ji Ning’s Mount Innerheart Training – Xiaoqing’s Greater Teleportation Breakthrough
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning commits to pure sword cultivation on Mount Innerheart. After 26 years, Xiaoqing reaches the Domain of Space, unlocking Greater Teleportation. A quiet but powerful chapter of growth.
og_title: The Tiers of Training – Ji Ning’s Sword-Only Grind Begins
og_description: Xiaoqing’s wild rain-dance victory seals a major breakthrough: she can now teleport between worlds. Ji Ning’s own climb through the puppet trials accelerates. Pure Xianxia satisfaction.
twitter_title: Xiaoqing just pulled a Greater Teleportation and declared herself invincible 😂
twitter_description: Ji Ning ditches all distractions for a sword-only grind. Meanwhile, his godbeast sidekick unlocks world-hopping teleportation. Mount Innerheart delivers.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme spatial ability that allows a cultivator to teleport directly from one world to another, crossing dimensional boundaries in an instant. Reached upon fully comprehending the Grand Dao of Space.
One of the exalted Grand Daos, governing the fundamental structure of spatial dimensions. Full comprehension unlocks Greater Teleportation.
The inner sanctum of Mount Innerheart where true great divine abilities and secret arts are taught. Only disciples who defeat a ninth-tier puppet may enter.
The main library and training hall of Mount Innerheart, divided into nine floors. Each floor contains higher-tier techniques and more difficult puppet trials.
A state of deep Dao comprehension where the cultivator’s soul merges with a Grand Dao, allowing them to manifest its power instinctively. A prerequisite for Greater Teleportation.
A combat challenge against an ancient puppet whose tactics evolve with each defeat. The trial forces pure technique and Dao comprehension, as divine abilities are banned.
Ji Ning’s personal spirit-beast, a Skygreen Serpent with innate talent for the Dao of Space. She was a powerful demon at Xiantian level and has grown significantly through cultivation.
Uncle White—Ji Ning’s eldest sworn uncle and godbeast companion. Extremely intelligent, he serves as both a guardian and a source of wisdom for Ji Ning.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a supreme spatial technique that allows a cultivator to teleport across world boundaries in an instant, unlike Lesser Teleportation which is limited to a single world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Ji Ning use divine abilities in the puppet trials?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The puppet trials are designed to test pure Dao comprehension and sword technique, so divine abilities and formations are deliberately banned to simulate a mirror match of the cultivator’s Dao realm.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How long has Ji Ning been on Mount Innerheart in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Roughly 30 years of in-novel time have passed since he first entered Mount Innerheart, during which he has dedicated himself entirely to sword cultivation.
